Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe

Class HydrocarbonPoolTransfer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.HydrocarbonPoolTransfer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class HydrocarbonPoolTransfer extends Object implements Serializable
Conductance- and heat-limited gas/oil transfer for a resolved hydrocarbon pool.

The local equilibrium flash supplies only the component inventory target. User-supplied overall transfer coefficients and an explicit interface width supply the kinetics. For component i, the unconstrained oil source is 

   Gamma_i = (k_i A_i / V) (m_i,oil,eq - m_i,oil)

where A_i/L = interfaceWidthFraction * diameter and V/L = pi diameter^2 / 4. Sources are donor limited for the accepted Euler interval and gas receives the exact opposite of every oil source. An optional externally supplied heat rate limits net endothermic transfer. The existing component and total-energy transports remain the inventory and energy owners.

Coefficients are explicit model inputs. This closure provides analytical and conservation qualification but is not a predictive evaporation correlation until its coefficients are independently validated.

1.0

  • Method Details

    • forHydrostaticPool

      public static HydrocarbonPoolTransfer forHydrostaticPool(String[] components, double[] coefficients, double[] evaporationEnthalpiesJPerKg, double maximumHeatSupplyWPerMetre)
      Construct a transfer closure using the volume-preserving static hydrostatic interface diagnostic in every cell.

      This is appropriate only for a resolved stationary or slowly draining stratified pool. It is not an annular, dispersed, slug-front or moving-pig area closure. A zero-area accepted gas cell with a positive equilibrium oil target uses that target's volume-preserving hydrostatic area for the appearance step; accepted pool geometry owns subsequent steps. When an inclined cell's retained volume is below the hydrostatic diagnostic's representable relative-volume tolerance, the closure reports and uses the local stratified chord area rather than deleting or clipping the trace inventory. A full liquid cell without a gas interface remains blocked.

      Parameters:
      components - unique NeqSim component names
      coefficients - overall transfer coefficients in m/s, one per component
      evaporationEnthalpiesJPerKg - positive evaporation heat requirements in J/kg, one per component
      maximumHeatSupplyWPerMetre - maximum external heat available to net evaporation in W/m; positive infinity disables this limit
      Returns:
      immutable hydrostatic-pool transfer closure
